anomaly_label: Overshooting pressure-control response of vacuum throttle valve (TV1)

evidence.observation: T701 reads 431.291 °C while the other reboiler heater reads 96.834 °C and the vessel reads 91.228 °C; the large discrepancy requires verification.
The discrepancy persists: T701 434.359 °C, T702 107.900 °C, and T703 96.765 °C; these data alone cannot distinguish a sensor fault from actual localized overheating.
Relative to 1080 s, pressure abruptly falls from 555.887 to 508.516 mbar, T711 rises from 72.324 to 82.755 °C, and distillate/reflux flows rise from 0.209/0.414 to 0.294/0.619.
Pressure remains below the preceding range at 518.701 mbar and T711 remains elevated at 82.375 °C.

args.missing_evidence: Independent H701 temperature measurement, heater power and temperature limits are needed to distinguish measurement error from overheating. Pressure setpoint and command history would establish whether the pressure transition was intended. No composition measurement or target composition has been supplied.
